welcomeTitle: A place for every bottle worth remembering.
welcomeBody: Log a wine in a moment, keep each person's opinion distinct, and let your own history become useful over time.
foundationBody: The Phase 0 foundation is running: an offline-ready shell, a typed API contract, and local-first development without production credentials.
healthUnavailable: API unavailable · your app shell is still safe offline

auth.signInTitle: Your wine memory, kept for you.
auth.signInBody: Sign in to keep your bottles, notes, and shared tastings inside the Spaces you choose.
auth.localEmulator: Local development mode · no real Google account is used.
auth.signInError: Sign-in could not start. Please try again.
auth.onboardingBody: Choose how you appear and the language you prefer. You can change both later.
auth.onboardingError: Your profile could not be saved. Your choices are still here; try again.
auth.authErrorBody: Va de Vi could not initialize its secure sign-in connection.
auth.sessionErrorTitle: Your private Space could not be opened.
auth.sessionErrorBody: Check the connection and try loading your session again.

space.switchError: That Space could not be opened.

spaces.newBody: Keep a wine memory for two people or bring a whole tasting group together.
spaces.coupleBody: A private Space designed for exactly two active members.
spaces.groupBody: A shared Space for friends, a club, or a recurring tasting table.
spaces.createError: The Space could not be created. Your choices are still here.
spaces.inviteBody: Create a private, single-use link that expires after seven days.
spaces.expiryNote: Share it privately. Anyone with this link can use it once before it expires.
spaces.manageError: That change could not be completed. Reload the Space and try again.
spaces.loadError: This Space is no longer available to your account.

invitation.title: Join {{space}}.
invitation.body: {{inviter}} invited you to join as {{role}}. Your own notes remain attributed to you.
invitation.singleUse: This link is single-use and expires after seven days.
invitation.acceptError: The invitation could not be accepted. It may have expired or already been used.
invitation.invalidBody: It may have expired, been revoked, or already been used. Ask the inviter for a new link.

pages.logBody: Manual wine capture arrives in Phase 2. This route is already part of the offline app shell.
pages.sessionsBody: Shared flights will preserve each participant's individual note.
pages.memoryBody: Your private cards, table, timeline, filters, and export will live here.
pages.assistantBody: The evidence-aware companion arrives behind server-authorized tools; no assistant is simulated in this foundation.
pages.notFoundTitle: That page is not in the cellar.
pages.notFoundBody: Return home and choose another path.
